playbook.thesis: Reach the target group many times at a low cost per view, then prove memory moved. Sales show up later in quick-commerce and kirana, not in click-throughs.
kpi: Ad recall and awareness lift (exposed vs control)
Quick-commerce search and sales lift in test cities
playbook.mix: 60% nano and micro creators in regional languages for cheap reach, 30% mid-tier, one macro anchor for salience.
playbook.formats: 15–30s Reels with the pack in the first 3 seconds; recipes and daily rituals; stories linking to Blinkit, Zepto and Instamart.
playbook.lang: 6 to 9 languages. Hindi and Hinglish first, then Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali and Kannada.
playbook.comp: Health-benefit claims (immunity, energy) need substantiation; Drugs & Magic Remedies Act applies to cure language; ASCI disclosure.

playbook.thesis: Every rupee should trace to an order. The job is CTR × conversion, net of returns, with new-customer share as the quality check.
kpi: Verified orders and revenue, net of returns
playbook.mix: Micro and mid-tier creators with high link CTR; storefront and affiliate links; a few macro creators only on sale days.
playbook.formats: Haul and 'what I bought' Reels, price-drop story stickers, live countdowns before sale events.
playbook.lang: Regional languages decide tier-2 and tier-3 conversion. Measure by language, not just by creator.
playbook.comp: Price claims must match the live listing; disclose affiliate earnings; the CCPA's dark-pattern rules apply to urgency claims.
playbook.moments: Great Indian Festival and Big Billion Days (Sep–Oct), EOSS (Jun, Dec), Pink Friday (Nov).

playbook.thesis: Beauty is bought on proof. Saves, tutorial completion and credible voices predict sales better than likes.
kpi: Saves per view and tutorial completion
PDP click-through and sampling to repeat
playbook.mix: Credentialed creators (dermatologists) for actives, micro creators for routines, K-culture Gen-Z creators for K-beauty.
playbook.formats: Get-ready-with-me videos, 7-day and 28-day challenges, ingredient explainers, honest before-and-after (no filters).
playbook.lang: English and Hinglish for premium; Hindi and regional languages for masstige makeup.
playbook.comp: ASCI: no filters that exaggerate results; technical skin claims need qualified creators; no 'cures acne'.
playbook.moments: Wedding season (Nov–Feb), festive glow (Oct–Nov), monsoon and summer skin.

playbook.thesis: Fashion runs on taste and on returns. Saves and shares show taste; return-adjusted revenue shows whether it sold.
kpi: Revenue net of returns (fashion returns run high)
playbook.mix: Micro creators with a distinct style, mid-tier for drops, one or two macro creators for launches.
playbook.formats: Try-on hauls, fit checks, styling one piece three ways, size-inclusive casting.
playbook.lang: English and Hinglish lead; Hindi and regional languages for value fashion.
playbook.comp: Disclose gifted products; avoid misleading 'sustainable' claims without proof (ASCI green claims).
playbook.moments: EOSS (Jun, Dec), wedding season, festive, back-to-college.

playbook.thesis: Trust is the product. A qualified creator with a smaller audience beats a large lifestyle account, and the rules require it for technical claims.
playbook.mix: Mid-tier doctors and dietitians as the spine, fitness creators for lifestyle use, micro creators for testimonials with disclosure.
playbook.formats: Myth-busting explainers, day-in-the-life, Q&A lives, routines without cure claims.
playbook.lang: Hindi and Hinglish first; regional languages for diagnostics and pharmacy.
playbook.comp: ASCI Addendum II (Apr 2025): technical health claims need qualified creators; Drugs & Magic Remedies Act; no disease-cure language.
playbook.moments: New-year resolutions (Jan), monsoon health (Jul–Sep), winter immunity.

playbook.thesis: Finance is the most regulated creator category. The engine gates who may speak, then optimises for funded accounts, not installs.
playbook.mix: SEBI-registered advisers and analysts for product talk; non-finance creators only for brand-scripted app experience.
playbook.formats: Long-form YouTube explainers, LinkedIn posts, Hinglish 'how I started my first SIP' with disclaimers.
playbook.lang: Hinglish and Hindi; Gujarati and Marathi over-index for investing.
playbook.comp: SEBI rules bar regulated entities from working with unregistered finfluencers who give advice or return claims; IRDAI for insurance; ASCI Addendum II.
playbook.moments: Tax-saving season (Jan–Mar), IPO windows, new financial year.

playbook.thesis: Tech is researched before it is bought. Depth and credibility of review content matter more than reach.
kpi: Search lift for the model name
playbook.mix: YouTube reviewers for depth, Shorts and Reels creators for launch buzz, gaming and education creators for laptops.
playbook.formats: Unboxings, 30-day reviews, comparisons, 'setup tour', student-life integrations.
playbook.lang: English and Hinglish; Hindi and Tamil for mass phones.
playbook.comp: No fake or paid-for reviews presented as organic (consumer protection rules on reviews); disclose free devices.
playbook.moments: Back to college (Jun–Aug), festive (Sep–Nov), launch weeks.

playbook.thesis: Services are local. City-level creators and redeemable codes tie spend to bookings and visits.
playbook.mix: City-specific micro and mid creators; diaspora creators for international routes (Dubai first).
playbook.formats: Real-experience vlogs, before-and-after, route launches, limited-time offers.
playbook.lang: City language first: Marathi in Pune, Kannada in Bengaluru, Malayalam for Gulf routes.
playbook.comp: Offer terms must match the app; service quality claims need substantiation.

playbook.thesis: Music and entertainment win by being used, not watched. Audio uses and shares are the leading signal.
playbook.mix: Meme-native comedy and dance creators, regional music creators, nano creators to seed a sound at scale.
playbook.formats: Dance challenges, duets, lip-syncs, release-week countdowns.
playbook.lang: Hindi, Punjabi and Tamil over-index; regional pride content travels.
playbook.comp: Copyright and licensing on audio; disclose label partnerships.
playbook.moments: Release weeks, Wrapped (Dec), wedding season playlists.
